criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 17 June 2028 (12 months after the 17 June 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($5,800,000 - $5,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 17 December 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 17 June 2033 (72 months after Closing).
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (17 June 2028), with days remaining from 10 May 2027 (404 days).
Notes that 17 June 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 19 June 2028.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
